sonnet.problem: The card says "the tallest mountains, the highest towers", but verses 14-15 say "all the tall mountains" and "every high tower". Changing tall to tallest and high to highest stretches the text outside a joke.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.

sonnet.problem: The question restates "the pride of man will be brought low, and the LORD alone will be exalted". That fact was already asked in Stop 2 card 10, where "exalted" was an answer. It reuses a shown answer and re-asks a repeated line (v17 repeats v11) inside the question.
sonnet.rule: An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.

sonnet.problem: The question says the house of Jacob "bows down to what their own fingers made", which almost hands over the blank. Card 6 had just told the same bowing. That setup rules out the wrong answers "prophets" and "soldiers".
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
